items.text: ·Continue adding further solvent and heating until all of the soluble solid has dissolved.

items.text: ·If insoluble impurities are present, then hot filtration could be done using fluted filter paper in a heated funnel.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Allow the liquid to cool until crystals of the organic solid have formed.

items.label: list_item
items.text: More crystalscan be obtained by cooling the solution below room temperature in an icebath.

items.label: list_item
items.text: The mixture is then filtered to remove soluble impurities using a Buchner funnel or a Hirsch funnel (fig C).

items.label: list_item
items.text: The crystals arewashed with a small amount of ice-cold solvent and then dried in a desiccator orwarmoven.
